📢 PEOPLES HIGHER SECONDARY SCHOOL, MALA, PANAJI

Peoples Higher Secondary School, Mala, Panaji, Goa, invites applications from eligible candidates for the following positions on a Regular Basis:

🔹 Teaching Positions:
• Physical Education Teacher – Post Graduate / B.P.Ed.
• Teacher Grade I – Biology – M.Sc. / B.Ed. in Botany, Zoology, Biotechnology or Microbiology
• Teacher Grade I – Accountancy / Secretarial Practice – M.Com / B.Ed. in Accountancy
• Teacher Grade I – English – M.A. / B.Ed. in English

🔹 Non-Teaching Positions:
• Librarian, Grade III – 1 Post (Graduate / B.Lib.Sc.)
• Multi-Tasking Staff – 2 Posts (S.S.C. / ITI preferred)
• Night Watchman – 1 Post (S.S.C. / ITI preferred)

📍 Location: Mala, Panaji, Goa

Interested and eligible candidates can submit their applications along with the required documents through email at peopleshss@gmail.com or personally at the school office.

📅 Last Date to Apply: 14th November 2026
